title: Restriction compatibility of the fixed section comparison
statement: For arbitrary f:X→S, L an O_X-module and k:W→S, the actual additive maps [def-sc-picard-direct-image-section-map] commute with derived restriction [def-sc-picard-derived-model-sections] under every successive base change i:T′→T and i≫t=t′. Given j:X_T′→X_T with the two prescribed projections, the inverse coefficient mate c applied at top after the presheaf restriction of the tensor adjunction unit on the section map of ξ equals the section map of the derived restriction of ξ. No bijectivity, flatness, properness or invertibility is asserted.

proof.text: Use the morphism-level pullback equality for the explicit unit morphisms. Transport its source by the tensor-to-ordinary left-adjoint comparison. The Hom equivalence takes that comparison to the canonical structure-sheaf map. Its naturality takes tensor pullback of the unit morphism to the adjunction unit on its value. Evaluate on one and use the general adjunction section evaluation lemma. Postcompose with c.inv and the evaluation identity of the explicit unit morphism to obtain the stated equality.

theorem picardDirectImageSectionMap_restriction
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{v},
      HasDerivedCategory.{v + 1} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (L : X.Modules) (W : Scheme.{v}) (k : W ⟶ S) :
    let E := (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f k)).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f k).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f k)).obj L))
    ∀ {T T' : Scheme.{v}} (i : T' ⟶ T) (t : T ⟶ W) (t' : T' ⟶ W)
        (h : i ≫ t = t')
        (j : pullback f (t' ≫ k) ⟶ pullback f (t ≫ k)),
        ∀ (hj₁ : j ≫ pullback.fst f (t ≫ k) = pullback.fst f (t' ≫ k)),
          j ≫ pullback.snd f (t ≫ k) = pullback.snd f (t' ≫ k) ≫ i →
          let c := (conjugateIsoEquiv
            ((Classical.choose (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction
              (pullback.fst f (t ≫ k)))).comp
                (Classical.choose (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction j)))
            (Classical.choose (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction
              (pullback.fst f (t' ≫ k))))).symm
            (Modules.pushforwardComp j (pullback.fst f (t ≫ k)) ≪≫
              Modules.pushforwardCongr hj₁)
          ∀ ξ : picardDerivedModelSections E t,
            (c.app L).inv.app ⊤
              (((Modules.tensorPullback j).obj
                ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (t ≫ k))).obj L)).presheaf.map
                  (homOfLE j.preimage_top.ge).op
                    (((Classical.choose (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction j)).unit.app
                      ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (t ≫ k))).obj L)).val.app
                        (Opposite.op ⊤)
                          (picardDirectImageSectionMap f L W k t ξ))) =
              picardDirectImageSectionMap f L W k t'
                (picardDerivedModelRestriction E i t t' h ξ)
